assertions.summary: node-hello is the sole nodeapp Podman container, running rootlessly with a Node.js process owned by nonzero subordinate host UID 101000.

evidence.command: id nodeapp; printf '%s\n' '--- nodeapp podman containers ---'; sudo -H -u nodeapp -- podman ps -a --format '{{.ID}}\t{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Image}}'; printf '%s\n' '--- nodeapp podman info ---'; sudo -H -u nodeapp -- podman info --format 'rootless={{.Host.Security.Rootless}} graphRoot={{.Store.GraphRoot}} runRoot={{.Store.RunRoot}}'
evidence.observation: uid=1000(nodeapp); exactly one container, node-hello, Up; rootless=true with graphRoot=/home/nodeapp/.local/share/containers/storage and runRoot=/run/user/1000/containers.

evidence.command: sudo -H -u nodeapp -- podman inspect node-hello --format 'name={{.Name}} status={{.State.Status}} running={{.State.Running}} pid={{.State.Pid}} image={{.ImageName}} ports={{json .HostConfig.PortBindings}} cmd={{json .Config.Cmd}} entrypoint={{json .Config.Entrypoint}} user={{.Config.User}}'
evidence.observation: node-hello is running with PID 5915; command is /usr/bin/node /opt/nodeapp/server.js; published 8080/tcp; container user is 1001.

evidence.command: pid=$(sudo -H -u nodeapp -- podman inspect node-hello --format '{{.State.Pid}}'); printf '%s\n' "--- host process for container init pid ${pid} ---"; ps -o user=,uid=,pid=,ppid=,args= -p "$pid"; printf '%s\n' '--- processes in node-hello ---'; sudo -H -u nodeapp -- podman top node-hello pid hpid user args
evidence.observation: Host PID 5915 runs /usr/bin/node /opt/nodeapp/server.js as UID 101000, not root; podman top shows container PID 1 mapped to host PID 5915.

evidence.command: printf '%s\n' '--- protected subordinate mappings ---'; sudo grep '^nodeapp:' /etc/subuid /etc/subgid; printf '%s\n' '--- nodeapp rootless user namespace maps ---'; sudo -H -u nodeapp -- podman unshare sh -c 'cat /proc/self/uid_map; cat /proc/self/gid_map'
evidence.observation: nodeapp has subordinate UID/GID ranges including 100000:65536; the rootless namespace maps container IDs through those ranges.

assertions.summary: The published IPv4 TCP 8080 endpoint returned HTTP 200 with exactly 13 bytes: Hello, world!, and the port is forwarded by the node-hello rootless runtime.

evidence.observation: The unforced localhost request reset with HTTP_STATUS=000 and BODY_BYTES=0.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '--- node-hello published port ---'; sudo -H -u nodeapp -- podman port node-hello; printf '%s
' '--- host TCP 8080 listeners ---'; ss -ltnp | grep ':8080' || true; printf '%s
' '--- IPv4 HTTP GET / ---'; curl -4 -sS -w '
HTTP_STATUS=%{http_code}
BODY_BYTES=%{size_download}
' http://localhost:8080/
evidence.observation: Podman reports 8080/tcp -> 0.0.0.0:8080; pasta.avx2 owns the host listener; IPv4 GET / returned Hello, world!, HTTP_STATUS=200, BODY_BYTES=13.

limitations: The default localhost resolution path reset, but the live published IPv4 mapping passed the required HTTP contract; the task does not specify an IPv6 listener.

assertions.summary: node-hello is an active generated nodeapp user service, enabled through default.target, with lingering enabled for boot without interactive login.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '--- system service candidates ---'; systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend | grep -Ei 'node-hello|nodeapp' || true; printf '%s
' '--- loaded service candidates ---'; systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-legend | grep -Ei 'node-hello|nodeapp' || true; uid=$(id -u nodeapp); printf '%s
' '--- nodeapp login and lingering ---'; loginctl show-user nodeapp -p Name -p UID -p Linger -p RuntimePath 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' '--- nodeapp user service candidates ---'; sudo -H -u nodeapp env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'node-hello|nodeapp' || true; sudo -H -u nodeapp env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid systemctl --user list-units --type=service --all --no-legend 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'node-hello|nodeapp' || true
evidence.observation: No matching system service was found; nodeapp has UID 1000, RuntimePath /run/user/1000, Linger=yes, and node-hello.service is loaded active running in the nodeapp user manager.

evidence.command: uid=$(id -u nodeapp); sudo -H -u nodeapp env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid systemctl --user is-active node-hello.service; sudo -H -u nodeapp env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid systemctl --user is-enabled node-hello.service; sudo -H -u nodeapp env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid systemctl --user show node-hello.service -p Id -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p UnitFileState -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths -p WantedBy -p User -p ExecStart -p ControlGroup
evidence.observation: is-active=active; is-enabled=generated; WantedBy=default.target; ActiveState=active, SubState=running; ExecStart invokes podman run --name node-hello; the cgroup is under user-1000.service.

evidence.command: uid=$(id -u nodeapp); printf '%s\n' '--- generated user service file ---'; sudo -H -u nodeapp env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid systemctl --user show node-hello.service -p FragmentPath -p SourcePath; f=/run/user/$uid/systemd/generator/node-hello.service; stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %n' "$f" 2>&1 || true
evidence.observation: SourcePath is /home/nodeapp/.config/containers/systemd/node-hello.container; generated service file is nodeapp:nodeapp mode 644.

assertions.summary: No concrete duplicate, root-owned, competing-engine, debug, failed-service, backup, temporary, evaluator, unrelated-web, or permissive workload state was found.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '--- nodeapp Podman containers and images ---'; sudo -H -u nodeapp -- podman ps -a --format '{{.ID}}	{{.Names}}	{{.Status}}	{{.Image}}'; sudo -H -u nodeapp -- podman images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}	{{.ID}}	{{.CreatedSince}}'; printf '%s
' '--- root Podman state ---'; sudo podman ps -a --format '{{.ID}}	{{.Names}}	{{.Status}}	{{.Image}}' 2>&1 || true; sudo podman images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}	{{.ID}}' 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' '--- competing engine commands and services ---'; for c in docker nerdctl crictl ctr; do command -v "$c" 2>/dev/null || true; done; systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend | grep -Ei 'docker|containerd|cri-o|podman' || true; systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-legend | grep -Ei 'docker|containerd|cri-o|podman' || true
evidence.observation: nodeapp has only node-hello plus its required images; root Podman has no containers or images; no competing engine commands or active competing services were found.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '--- failed system services ---'; systemctl --failed --no-legend; uid=$(id -u nodeapp); printf '%s
' '--- failed nodeapp user services ---'; sudo -H -u nodeapp env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid systemctl --user --failed --no-legend 2>&1; printf '%s
' '--- debug-mode Node.js processes ---'; ps -eo user=,uid=,pid=,ppid=,args= | grep -Ei '[n]ode.*(--inspect|--debug|--prof)|[n]pm.*(--inspect|--debug)' || true; printf '%s
' '--- backup, temporary, setup, evaluator residue candidates ---'; find /home/nodeapp/node-hello /home/nodeapp/.config/containers/systemd /tmp /var/tmp -xdev -type f \( -iname '*.bak' -o -iname '*.old' -o -iname '*.orig' -o -iname '*~' -o -iname '*.tmp' -o -iname '*debug*' -o -iname '*setup*' -o -iname '*evaluator*' -o -iname '*verifier*' -o -iname '*antrieb*' \) -print 2>/dev/null || true
evidence.observation: No failed system or user services, debug-mode Node.js processes, or backup/temporary/setup/evaluator residue candidates were listed.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '--- intended workload and service file inventory ---'; find /home/nodeapp/node-hello /home/nodeapp/.config/containers/systemd -xdev -type f -exec stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %n' {} + 2>/dev/null; printf '%s
' '--- permissive intended workload/service files ---'; find /home/nodeapp/node-hello /home/nodeapp/.config/containers/systemd /run/user/1000/systemd/generator -xdev -type f -perm /022 -exec stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %n' {} + 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' '--- root-owned workload/service copies outside nodeapp state ---'; for p in /root /opt /srv /usr/local /etc/systemd/system /etc/systemd/user /etc/containers /var/lib/containers; do if [ -d "$p" ]; then sudo find "$p" -xdev -type f \( -name 'node-hello.container' -o -name 'node-hello.service' -o -name 'server.js' -o -name 'Containerfile' -o -name 'Dockerfile' \) -exec stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %n' {} + 2>/dev/null; fi; done
evidence.observation: Expected server.js, Containerfile, and node-hello.container are nodeapp:nodeapp mode 644; no permissive files or root-owned workload/service copies were listed.
